description: Frozen decisions of the primary engine reference (stages 05-07). Protocol = the original cloned-population benchmark entry point engine_benchmark.evaluate_engine_benchmark on the pinned snapshot, with the accepted configuration injected through release.resolved_configs and the accepted quota calibration. Nothing here is tuned after seeing outcomes.

equivalence.note: run A = pinned engine entry point, run B = packaged wrapper; discrete values exact, floats within float_atol; gate for stages 06-08

intervention_audit.note: direct per-e rollouts (one game per grid point) on a subset of the calibration cohort, compared with the quota-threshold protocol on the same players and rollout seeds; a documented comparison, not a replacement of the reference

intervention_semantics: E enters the structural model only through the served goal quota (S0.goals_left); outcomes under do(E=e) are the quota-threshold outcomes of one full-budget game per replicate (reuse_goal_totals=True, the original protocol)

mc_calibration.cohort_seed_source: configs/seeds.json (SHA-256 derived; not in the reserved set)
mc_calibration.comparison: each candidate R is compared with 2R on the same cohort (R = 256 has no comparator and is accepted only if nothing smaller passes)

criteria.mc_se_definition: sqrt(sum_p var_r(h_p(e,r)) / R) / N at every grid point (replicate variance only, players fixed)
criteria.recommendation_rule: e*_R == e*_2R, or every candidate optimum's neighbour cost g(e* +- 0.25) - g(e*) <= 0.005 on the 2R surface (flat minimum)
criteria.regret_change_definition: |Regret_R(e_obs,R) - Regret_2R(e_obs,2R)| where Regret = g(e_obs) - g(e*) on the same surface

mc_calibration.prefix_rule: rollout seeds SeedSequence([exogenous_seed, r]) do not depend on R, so R = 16 / 32 / 64 / 128 are exact prefixes of the R = 256 surface
mc_calibration.selection: final R = smallest candidate passing every criterion against its doubling on all three levels, with floor 32

name: engine_reference
observational_quantity: assignment-weighted engine conditional expectation m_obs(e) from compare_engine_curves (natural assignment density); the HF empirical binned churn-vs-logged-E curve is a separate diagnostic named empirical_logged_churn_by_E
tie_rule: causal_queries.select_grid_optimum reused unchanged: candidates = grid[np.isclose(values, min, atol=1e-12)] (default rtol), then smallest |e|, then smallest e

validation.gates: every gate of the original comparison_report + bootstrap interval gates (engine_level_report): gap >= 1.0, causal contrast >= 0.02, obs contrast <= -0.02, shoulders >= 0.01, ESS fraction >= 0.20, max weight <= 0.01, intervals exclude 0
validation.label: new estimates (new R, 512 players); the historical 15/15 and 13/15 counts cannot currently be verified
